title: Jammy Algerian Doraji Tagine
description: A comforting and chewy vegan dish featuring bellflower root doraji, dehydrated to perfection in a rich and flavorful tagine sauce.
instructions: Dehydrate the doraji in a low temperature oven at 150 degrees for 2 hours.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger to the pot and saute until the onion is translucent.
Add the cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the canned tomatoes and vegetable broth to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the dehydrated doraji to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the sauce to a jammy consistency.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
